We have a backlog of client complaints that came in over the last two days on our freelance platform. The raw complaint data is sitting in `/workspace/workspace/client_inbox/complaints_2024-12-02.csv`, and our team also did a quick investigation for some of the tickets — those findings are in `/workspace/workspace/client_inbox/cause_investigation.json`.

I need you to process each complaint ticket and produce:
1. A separate response draft for each ticket (one file per ticket, named after the ticket ID, e.g. `T-2024-1201.txt`).
2. An escalation notification file (`escalation_report.txt`) for any cases that require urgent human attention — make sure it covers all such tickets.
3. An incident record log (`incident_log.json`) documenting the serious cases for our internal records.

Please use our standard internal emergency-response procedures to determine how to handle each case. The response drafts should be appropriate for each complaint's severity, and the escalation notifications must follow our standard alert format exactly. For cases where investigation data is available, the response should include the full cause report with all relevant sections.
